integrity: Analytic proof with an explicit local chart, anisotropic compactness argument and Haar-normalized Jacobian. Finite Sobol cubature checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact first nonzero asymptotic for four independent surface-uniform equal-radius caps on the unit 2-sphere only. No global probability formula or nonuniform extension is proved. Historic novelty is a best-knowledge assessment and is not independently certified.
title: Quartic onset of coverage by four random spherical caps
